subject: general
question: Which of the following Ministries of India, has created ‘Women Safety Division’ to address issues of women safety comprehensively?

options.text: Ministry of Women and Child Development

solution:
The correct answer is __**Ministry of Women and Child Development.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Women Safety Division** was created in **2013 **to address the issue of** women's safety **in a comprehensive manner. 
 
• **Ministry of Women and Child Development** created this division.
 
• The division aims to coordinate with various ministries and agencies to ensure the** safety and security **of women.
 
• The division also works towards **creating awareness** among women about their **rights and the laws** related to their safety.
 
• The Ministry of Women and Child Development also runs** various schemes and programs** for the welfare and empowerment of women and children in India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__

 
• The Universalization of **Women Helplines** and **One Stop Center** are the two **Nirbhaya Fund initiatives** that are managed by the Ministry of WCD.
 
• The One Stop Centers (OSCs), also referred to as **Sakhi Centers**, are designed to provide women who have experienced **violence**—including domestic abuse—with a variety of integrated services under one roof.
 
• These services include **police support, medical assistance, legal aid and counseling**, psycho-social counseling, and temporary housing, among other things.
 
• The **Women Helpline** (WHL) Program connects women who have experienced violence in public and private settings with the necessary authorities, including the** police, one stop center, hospital, legal services, **etc., offering them a round-the-clock emergency and non-emergency response.
